706:t_1:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「...So, what exactly is this $$カオス・コスモス$$ anyway?」

706:t_1:5.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Apparently, it's some parallel world. But even sending open transmissions in every direction hasn't gotten a single reply.」

706:t_1:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Won't the $$御使い$$s find us if we do that?」

706:t_1:7.en:
$$青山$$
「We've practically been under their surveillance since we came to this universe. It's a bit late to worry now.」

706:t_1:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So they're watching us wherever we go...」

706:t_1:9.en:
$n
(This pressure I've felt ever since we came to this universe... It's driving us into a corner...)

706:t_1:10.en:
$$タケル$$
「$c is using this universe's properties to make repeated long-distance jumps, tracing the $$御使い$$s' will.」

706:t_1:11.en:
$$甲児$$
「If we keep going, we'll run into them somewhere, huh?」

706:t_1:12.en:
$$赤木$$
「Still, it's creepy that nobody's replying.」

706:t_1:13.en:
$$勝平$$
「Maybe... there's nobody left alive in this universe...」

706:t_1:15.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「...It's true that I can't feel the breath of life in this world...」

706:t_1:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「Those bastards...! Did they wipe out everyone in their way from the universe they live in...?!」

706:t_1:17.en:
$n
「Then they remade this world however they wanted... That's what $$カオス・コスモス$$ is...」

706:t_1:18.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But we know we and the $$御使い$$s aren't the only ones in this universe.」

706:t_1:19.en:
$$タケル$$
「There's $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$... and $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$.」

706:t_1:20.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So there's nobody but enemies after all...」

706:t_1:23.en:
$$タケル$$
「I remembered when $$ズール$$ and $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ appeared before. They said they needed to prepare before fighting us.」

706:t_1:24.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I remember too. But since then, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ and the others have appeared without fighting us.」

706:t_1:26.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Do you have any idea, $$グーラ$$?」

706:t_1:27.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「If something's bothering you, tell us. We need every bit of information we can get right now.」

706:t_1:28.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...I think Father's and $$皇帝ズール$$'s ultimate goal was to defeat the $$御使い$$s.」

706:t_1:29.en:
$$赤木$$
「That's how it seemed when the Galactic Raid Fleet set sail too.」

706:t_1:30.en:
$$青山$$
「So they were trying to take Earth to fight the $$御使い$$s after all?」

706:t_1:31.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Perhaps the preparations Father and the others spoke of were for invading this $$カオス・コスモス$$...」

706:t_1:32.en:
$$タケル$$
「In other words, their goal was to make us wipe out $$バアル$$ and expose the $$天柱$$...」

706:t_1:33.en:
$$甲児$$
「They were going to use our power to get here?」

706:t_1:35.en:
$$グーラ$$
「The army of darkness has probably entered $$カオス・コスモス$$ as well.」

706:t_1:37.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The $$御使い$$s, $$アサキム$$, $$ヴィルダーク$$... Or is it...」

706:t_1:38.en:
$$甲児$$
「Whichever it is, they're still our enemies!」

706:t_1:39.en:
$$タケル$$
「Do we... have no choice but to fight...?」

706:t_1:40.en:
$n
(If we keep fighting like this... can we win...?)

707:t_000:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「...So this is the galactic center, long shrouded in mystery.」

707:t_000:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It's spectacularly empty, just ordinary outer space.」

707:t_000:2.en:
$$尸刻$$
「The $$グレートアトラクター$$ that was here disappeared into the dimensional gap because of $c's $$時空震動弾$$.」

707:t_000:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That was not all that disappeared. $c itself did too.」

707:t_000:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Knowing them, I'm sure they're alive and well.」

707:t_000:6.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Yes... They are probably heading toward $$サイデリアル$$'s rulers.」

707:t_000:7.en:
$$尸刻$$
「And His Majesty probably is as well...」

707:t_000:8.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「His Majesty $$アウストラリス$$... He challenges God, carrying the feelings Lady $$エルーナ$$ and the others entrusted to him...」

707:t_000:9.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ has already half collapsed, so calling him His Majesty is rather odd now.」

707:t_000:10.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But even if $$サイデリアル$$ falls, the pride of $$ハイアデス$$ will never fade...!」

707:t_000:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「We survivors should clear out the remaining $$バアル$$ and get to work cleaning up the aftermath.」

707:t_000:12.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Talks will soon begin with Earth's representatives, the organizations in the operation, and representatives of various species.」

707:t_000:13.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Earth defeated $$サイデリアル$$ and stopped $$バアル$$'s invasion. It will probably lead this galaxy now...」

707:t_000:14.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Earth's people held onto the unyielding fighting spirit and hope fading from this galaxy... That power must have defeated $$バアル$$.」

707:t_000:15.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「And the future was protected. A new era begins here.」

707:t_000:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Of course, that assumes the merciless emissaries of God allow humanity to exist.)

707:t_000:17.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(If you think of it that way, this universe's future of despair won't change even if $$バアル$$ is destroyed...)

707:t_000:18.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Just how much longer... will we be permitted to live...?)

712:t_1:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
(Forgive me, $$ドゥリタラー$$, $$ウィルパーシャ$$... and $$ヴァイシュラバ$$...)

712:t_1:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
(I could not fulfill my duty as a Dimensional General... Even if I meet you, all I can do is apologize...)

712:t_1:7.en:
???
「This is where the force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist meet...」

712:t_1:8.en:
???
「You still have things you must do...」

712:t_1:13.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「It seems you've meddled again.」

712:t_1:15.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Do you have no intention of changing your mind?」

712:t_1:17.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ is finally back too, so let's have fun together, all four of us again.」

712:t_1:18.en:
???
「I have never once considered it fun.」

712:t_1:19.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Do you intend to abandon your duty as a higher-dimensional life-form?」

712:t_1:21.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「What you did amounts to rebellion against our very existence.」

712:t_1:23.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Very well, $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$. Then spend eternity within this dimensional prison.」

712:t_1:24.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Regrettably, I will erect a barrier as well. You no longer have your freedom.」

712:t_1:25.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「That is our punishment for you.」
